Government orders removal of Chinese app after e-rickshaw hacking videos

The Indian government has ordered Apple and Google to remove the BAT-BMS application from their app stores following viral videos showing e-rickshaws being remotely disabled. The app reportedly uses Bluetooth to connect to e-rickshaw battery systems and shut them down. Reports indicate the government's action is a response to security concerns raised by these prank videos, which have caused disruption and led to complaints from e-rickshaw drivers.
